tile01.layout: Opening of the scroll: open spring countryside, no buildings, no boats. The upper two thirds (y 0-1000) are a flat misty field with bare, just-budding trees: one big leaning tree at the left (trunk x 60-150), a second trunk cut by the left tile edge, a tall slender tree in the middle (trunk x 490-545) with a dead broken snag beside it, and a large forked tree at the right (base x 560-720) whose long branch runs right to x 1060. A dirt path runs across the field at y about 870-1000; on it, at x 110-325, two laden donkeys and a drover walk left (toward the city), the head of the charcoal donkey train that continues in tile02. Below the path the ground drops in a rocky, ink-washed river bank (far bank, y 980-1300) to the water, which fills y 1250-1800; a low sandbar/shoal lies in the water at the lower left (y 1370-1470) and a dark wash band along the bottom (y 1600-1770) reads as the near shore or mist. The right third of the tile (x 700-1100) is empty silk apart from four red collector seals (at approximately [740,60,990,320], [890,800,1030,1000], [850,1150,1060,1360], [920,1620,1080,1770]); these are later impressions, not scene objects, and are not listed in entries.

tile02.layout: Opening countryside scene, no buildings. Top band (y 150-700) is a dense grove of bare trees: three large gnarled trunks on the left bank (x 150-640, bases at y 1150-1200) and two large spreading trees on the right (x 545-1100, bases y 820-1100), with pale distant tufted trees along the top (y 165-400). A mist/wash band runs at y 640-720 behind a flat path on the far bank (y 700-920, x 560-1100) along which a charcoal donkey train walks leftward, led by one driver. Below the path a bank edge curves at y 960-1000 and a wooden trestle footbridge (x 540-990, y 995-1100) crosses a creek; a small empty punt is moored below the bridge (x 560-832, y 1127-1215). The creek water lies at y 1040-1230 and opens into the river/marsh that fills the bottom (y 1200-1800), with a dark sand spit at y 1290-1400 and horizontal mist/water bands near the bottom. Left bank land with tree roots occupies x 0-560, y 1100-1270.

tile03.layout: Opening rural section: no water occupies the upper half; the upper band (y 150-840) is a treeline of misty grove trees on the right (x 700-1100) and a large pollarded willow in the centre (x 400-735). A farmstead sits at left on a field/ground band (y 585-1000): a tiled-roof farmhouse behind, a thatched hut with brushwood fence in front-left, and an open thatched shed with tables and a bench to its right; a rounded distant hill rises behind at x 60-235. Below y ~1000 the ground dissolves into mist and the river: dark horizontal wash bands at y 1170-1330 mark the near shoals/bank, and the rest down to y 1800 is open water/mist with faint streak texture. At the far right (x 1020-1100, y 1005-1245) low hummocks with reeds form the far bank continuing into tile02. No road, bridge or boats are visible; no clearly drawn people - one doubtful figure under the shed.

tile04.layout: Rural opening scene with no road or bridge. The top band (y 170-950) is a grove of large leafless trees on the far bank, with two thatched farm compounds behind the trunks: a left compound (x 55-455, y 658-872: farmhouse, round shed, small shelter, haystack, a round drum-like object on a frame) and a right compound (x 765-1100, y 598-832: dome-shaped thatched hut, two gable-roofed thatched houses, a front hut with fence) with a large pale conical mound (haystack or distant hillock) behind it. Below the grove the far bank is flat open ground/field drawn with soft contour strokes (y 950-1200). A band of fine horizontal streaks at y about 1200-1520 reads as the river surface (water); the near bank at the bottom (y 1515-1800) is a line of pale boulders with dark ink washes. Only one clear figure (a walking man at x~660) and one doubtful animal; no boats, vehicles or sedans.

tile05.layout: Pure landscape section with no figures, animals or boats. The upper ~55% (y 0-900) is a grove of bare, crab-claw-branched trees on the far bank: a loose group at upper left (x 0-240, y 370-700), a tall central group (x 470-770, y 230-900) and a dense tall group at right (x 780-1100, y 180-960). Among the trunks sit two thatched huts (main hut x 495-845, y 690-895; second hut x 870-1100, y 655-800) with scrub bushes around them. A large pollarded willow with a thick knotted trunk at the left edge (x 0-545, y 630-1250) spreads its fine twigs over the bank. Below the huts the ground is a raised earthen bank/mound (y 880-1250) with ink bank-edge lines. Water occupies the lower part (y ~1230-1800): broad dark ink washes for the river surface at y 1300-1420 and y 1450-1620, with lighter unpainted sand shoals between them; small dark tufts (reeds/grass) at the bottom right corner (y 1720-1800).

tile06.layout: The whole tile is a bare early-spring willow grove on dry ground; there is no water, no building, no person, no animal and no vehicle anywhere in it. The foreground (y 1100-1800) is a bank/ground slope rendered with long horizontal ink-wash strokes, rising from bottom right toward the upper left; a darker wash band at y 1560-1800 may be a path or the edge of the bank nearest the viewer. Five large pollarded willows (trunks cut back, crowns of dense fine upright shoots, gnarled knotted trunks with burls) stand on this ground with their bases between y 1230 (far right, further away) and y 1600 (central tree, nearest); their crowns of shoots fill y 300-1000 across the full width. Behind them (y 150-650) a receding line of faint, pale distant trees (crab-claw twig clusters, thin trunks) fades into blank silk at the top, giving a treeline / far-bank band. Reading order: the ground is highest at the left, so the left trees stand further up-slope; bases step down toward the lower right.

tile07.layout: Rural willow grove with no road traffic. The upper two thirds (y 0-1000) are filled by crowns of bare, pollarded willows drawn as fine twig sprays, with faint horizontal field/ground lines behind them (y 330-490) and a single walking figure cut by the left edge at y 330-460 on an upper path. The middle band (y 850-1450) holds the gnarled trunks of five or six willows standing on an earthen bank; their bases lie at y 1280-1460 so the bank/path band is about y 1240-1450. At left (x 0-370, y 1000-1250) a thatched lean-to shed with thin posts shelters a large lidded jar and a round basin on a stand; a brushwood fence with stacked brush stands in front of it (x 0-180, y 1090-1310) and a dark gnarled stump at x 50-190, y 1290-1430. The lower band (y 1430-1800) is rendered with long parallel flowing wash strokes bounded above by an eroded bank edge at left and dark boulders/roots under the big willow at right; it reads as the river (water) seen along the near bank, though a wash-rendered ground slope cannot be excluded. No boats, animals, vehicles, sedans or signs are visible.

tile08.layout: No water in this tile; the scene is dry countryside west of the suburbs. The top half (y 0-520) is a bare willow grove with a faint walled farmstead far back at upper left (x 60-360, y 300-430). A sloping dirt road comes down from the upper right (x~1000, y~300) diagonally to the lower left (x 0, y~780); on it the tomb-sweeping party descends: porter with pole, two horsemen, three walking attendants, the willow-decked sedan with two bearers, and a running courier ahead. A huge bare willow (x 130-1010, y 540-1250) dominates the centre, overhanging two farmhouses: a tile/thatch house on the left (x 0-330, y 920-1200) and a tile-roofed house with thatch annex and brushwood-fenced courtyard on the right (x 615-990, y 945-1300). The bottom band (y 1320-1700) is a wide dirt road along the front of the fences on which a small family group travels left: donkey, man with pole, woman on a led donkey, man leading it.

tile09.layout: Rural outskirts, no river in this tile. Top band (y 0-330) is open farmland drawn as horizontal furrow lines with a diagonal raised dike/field path crossing it (x 230-335); a tiny farmer with implements sits at the top-left field (y ~100-150). Middle band (y 330-700) holds a farmstead at the left: a thatched house with a railed shed in front, a standing ox, a lying ox, two stone rollers in the yard, and large bare winter willows (x 380-1000, y 80-640) with a low hillock contour behind them (y 500-600). Right of centre (y 560-850) is bare ground with a tiny distant figure, a running porter and a donkey rolling on its back. Centre (y 900-1200) has a tiled-roof house with an open front pavilion (x 660-1100) and a grassy mound with a forked post beside which a man stands pointing. A grove of thin bare trees and a huge bare willow (left) frame the road band (y 1280-1560), where the tail of the tomb-sweeping procession passes leftward: a porter with a shoulder pole, a hooded woman riding a donkey, and a servant with a staff and back-load. The bottom band (y 1570-1800) is an ink-washed earth bank/slope, possibly the edge of a stream, with no visible water surface.

tile10.layout: No open water except the bottom-left corner: wavy water lines at x 0-560, y 1690-1800, where a large cargo boat is moored stern-right under the willows (its hull runs off the tile to the left). The lower half (y 760-1800) is a willow grove on the near bank, dominated by a huge pollarded willow whose trunk stands at x 520-800, y 1480-1800; a man with a pole walks through reeds at x 755-850, y 950-1040. The middle band (y 290-710) is the roadside: a large open thatched tea/wine shed at x 0-660 with tables, five people and a saddled horse, tile-roofed houses behind it, and to the right (x 830-1100) a thatched stall with a lattice railing, three figures and a brown ox lying in front, framed by two large willows. The top band (y 20-335) is the far ground: a tiled pavilion at top-left, a row of distant thatched houses along a lane (y 40-125), bare trees, long field-path/dike lines, and three tiny figures with loads on the far lane at top right.

tile11.layout: The tile shows the quay in front of the riverside restaurants just downstream (left) of the Rainbow Bridge area. Top band y0-300: a tree line with bare trees, one dark leafy tree, a square pavilion on a raised terrace with stairs at the top right (x795-1060), and large tiled roofs of houses and shops at the top left. Street/plaza band y300-960: on the left a two-storey shop with a counter and a big vat (x0-350) with a decorated-gate scaffold at the left edge; left-centre a large tea house with an arched tiled roof and a trellis pavilion full of tables (x0-520, y450-900) and a tall bunting pole; centre-right an open eating shed with tables (x470-800, y270-535) and a thatched shop (x760-1100, y340-640). On the open ground in front are a group of four men greeting and a gang of porters handling grain sacks round a seated overseer (x480-960, y600-960). The quay edge runs from x0,y1000 to x900,y1120; below it is the river (y1000-1800) with three moored cargo boats, the big one on the left with its rudder lowered and a rung-beam up to the quay, two smaller ones to the right under a huge bare willow. A sandbank of the near shore occupies the bottom-left corner (x0-340, y1480-1800). No animals or vehicles appear in this tile.

tile12.layout: The tile is a river bend seen from the far side. Top band (y 0-340) is the upper street running right-left: at the left a donkey rider, a squatting porter and the tall standing sign 王家紙馬 in front of an open-front tile-roofed shop (x 295-735); to its right a timber frame of poles with woven panels (a huanmen skeleton or workshop) in front of a large house whose roof fills the top-right corner, with a shopkeeper, a seated worker and a counter vendor, and two carry-pole porters walking along the street. The middle band (y 340-920) is dominated by a large open riverside shed/restaurant (x 420-1100) with a long tile roof, a reed-mat lean-to awning, tables and benches and a huge round mat canopy, bounded toward the river by a post-and-rail fence along the bank; to the left a group of large bare willows with one gnarled leaning trunk and a wattle-fenced yard. The water fills the bottom (y about 850-1800), a sandy bank tongue descends at x 200-650 to y about 1000; three boats are moored at the left edge (mat-arch cabin boat with a passenger looking out) and a large cargo boat with mat-arch cabin and closed hatch lies at the lower right, without visible crew. No bridge, road along the near bank or far-bank buildings in this tile.

tile13.layout: Water fills the bottom half: open water with ripple lines from the boat hulls (y about 1000) down to the bottom edge (y 1800), with no objects on it; moored boats occupy y 580-1060 along the whole width. The boats lie against the far (upper) bank, which is a timber-stilt quay and earth bank at y 530-660. Above it (y 150-600) stands a riverside building block: a large tiled gable-roof restaurant whose river-side room (x 0-190) is open with a lattice balustrade and tables, a bamboo-mat-walled annex (x 190-525), a white compound wall with tiled coping (x 520-765), a hip-gable hall roof behind (x 525-835), and a very large bare willow at the right (x 730-1100). The top band (y 10-168) is a street running left-right behind the block: a continuous row of open-front shops (eatery, umbrella stall, counter shop, eatery) along y 10-140 with the street itself at y 128-168, three animals and a few figures, then a bamboo fence, a big tree and a small shop at the right. Foreground boats: boat 2 (stern with helmsman at x 300) at left and the large boat 3 (x 300-1095, big rudder at right) in front of the quay.

tile14.layout: The far bank runs along the top: a street with an open tea shed and an umbrella stall lies behind the roofs at y 0-165, and a tall huanmen pole scaffold rises at the top left (x 50-425). Below the street a row of tiled buildings occupies y 72-565: a gable house and plastered wall at the left (x 0-372), a two-storey wine house with board sign, striped banner and a railed ramp to the bank in the middle (x 395-730), and an open dining hall on a raised floor with lattice panels and a plank quay at the right (x 648-1100). The bank itself is a narrow strip at y 440-650 where two men stand talking. The water fills y 530-1800; four moored boats lie along the quay between y 528 and 1232 (upper-left cargo boat, a bundle-laden boat with a cooking shelter at the quay, the large broadside cargo boat x 330-1100, and a passenger boat with a big rudder at the bottom left); the lower half of the tile (y 1230-1800) is open rippled water with nothing on it.

tile15.layout: The far-bank street runs across the top of the tile (y 0-300): on the left an open-fronted shop with tables, in the centre a two-wheeled freight cart drawn by two donkeys moving left, with a led horse behind it, and on the right a two-storey wine house (y 230-520) with a bundled-pole huanmen on its roof and a three-strip cloth sign. Between street and water (y 300-470) three porters carry sacks leftward on the bank; the bank/quay line is at y 480-525. The water fills y 500-1730. Moored boats crowd the middle band (y 490-900): a left boat with two seated men, a boat seen stern-on with its rudder, and a mat-arch cabin boat at the right. The foreground (y 780-1232) is a big towed boat with a long plank cabin, mast up, and a tow line running off to the left; open water with ripples below it.

tile16.layout: The far bank occupies the top of the tile (y 0-515): behind it a mass of tile roofs of a large building complex (y 55-260) with a small hanging sign at the top; in front, a two-storey riverside restaurant on stilts (x 0-520, y 180-510) with guests on its open upper floor, and to its right an open reed-mat awning shed full of tables and benches (x 520-945, y 180-425). At the top right (x 850-1100, y 45-355) a street runs in front of an open-front shop with men seated at tables and a porter walking by. The water fills everything below y ~505 to the bottom (y 1800), with the stilts of the restaurant standing in it. Three large boats crowd the upper water: boat 1 (left, bow right, mast lowered, lattice cabin) at y 505-912, boat 2 (upper right, bow left, windlass frame, coiled hawsers) at y 495-785, and boat 3 (foreground, stern left with sweep, lattice cabin) at y 850-1185; a tow rope rises from the boats to the upper right bank and several stays cross boats 2 and 3. The lower half of the tile (y 1200-1800) is open water with wave lines, apart from a small-boat fragment at the bottom-left corner.

tile17.layout: The upper quarter (y 0-480) is the far bank with a big riverside wine house: a large tiled main hall across the top, a lean-to annex with a lattice window band, a two-storey wing at the right standing on piles over the water with an open upper gallery where patrons sit, and at the left a walled house with a closed plank gate, a wattle fence and a huge old bare tree. The bank slopes down from y~330 to the water; a single tracker at top-left hauls a tow rope that runs diagonally across the tile to the lowered mast of a big cargo boat (y 480-900) moving left. Water fills y~450-1750. At lower left the bow of a second boat enters the tile with five men pushing a very long sweep oar out to the right (y 800-1130). Along the bottom (y 1380-1720) a boat is moored to the near shore, laundry drying on its mat cabin, a woman/man pouring a basin over the side and a large rudder at its stern; a fragment of another boat shows at the left edge. No road, no vehicles or animals in this tile.

tile18.layout: The river fills the whole middle of the tile: water runs from the far-bank edge at y~150 (top) down to the near-bank mound and houses at y~1400. The far bank is the top band (y 0-160) with a riverside house and an open-front shop at the upper left and a sloping tow path on the upper right along which five trackers haul a rope toward the left; a large willow stands at the upper-right corner. A big moored cargo boat with cabins and a hung rudder lies along the far bank at the upper left, with a second boat behind it. The water in the centre has eddies; a boat enters from the right edge at mid-height with seven crewmen heaving on a line on its bow. The near bank is the bottom band: bare trees and an enormous old willow on the left (y 330-1390), a pale earthen mound in the centre (y 1385-1560), thatched and tiled roofs of houses in the lower-left corner, and at lower right a moored open boat, a masted boat at the edge and two men (one in a very wide hat) at the water's edge in the foreground.

tile19.layout: Far bank runs along the top (ground y~150-260): at top-left an open shed with tables under a big willow, a slat fence and a reed-mat shed in the middle, and a tiled shop with shelving at top-right; four boats are moored along it (y 150-330). Open water fills y~250-1230 with eddies; a large boat with a mat roof, wicker jars and a lattice cabin crosses it at y 245-480, a passenger boat lies at the left edge, a fisherman sits in the fronds at (680,660), and a small boat is tucked by the right willow at (850,890). Two tow/mooring lines cross the water (y~545 and the diagonal y 835->780). The near bank occupies the bottom: two moored boats (y 1050-1300) seen through bare willows, a group of five people on the bank at x 730-970, y 1230-1430, and large tiled roofs seen from above (y 1200-1800) with an umbrella stall and a porter at bottom-left. Bands: far_bank = y<260, water = 250-1230, near_bank/street_south = y>1230 (left side from y>1430).

tile20.layout: Upper-left: the Rainbow Bridge (timber arch) spans x 0-640, deck/railing y 170-330, its underside of slanted timber beams y 280-470 and a railing/revetment seen through the arch at y 465-580; 14 people crowd the near railing of the deck (y 170-310) leaning toward the boat. Above and beyond the bridge, the far-bank street runs along the top edge (y 15-135, x 0-560) with an umbrella stall, a porter and walkers, and a two-wheeled cart (x 425-590, y 115-228); at the bridge's right foot stand a vane pole with crossbar (x 610-660, y 22-340), vending tables and a large two-storey tea house with a mat awning and many tables/benches (x 645-1100, y 20-290), under a big willow at top right. The middle is water (y ~300-1210) filled by the large boat in trouble lying diagonally from its bow at lower-left (x 95, y 700-820) to its stern at upper-right (x 1070, y 300-450): mast lowered diagonally (x 615-895, y 165-495) in a tangle of rigging, 23 crew (some uncertain) poling, pointing, shouting and hauling; the dark mat roof of a neighbouring boat shows at the right edge (y 270-345); bare willow branches hang over the water at right (x 800-1100, y 690-1000). Lower: boats moored along the near bank (y 1050-1212); three men on the roof of the left one (x 460-770) wave and shout at the big boat; then the near-bank buildings seen from above: a lattice awning and umbrellas at left (y 1070-1290), a huge tiled roof (x 230-1065, y 1170-1460) over an open-front restaurant whose interior (y 1440-1620) shows tables, diners and waiters, an umbrella stall at right (x 728-1025, y 1440-1710), a dark tree at the right edge and more tiled roofs at the bottom (y 1575-1790). Bands: far_bank y<300 (above the bridge and right of it), bridge_deck y 170-330 (x<640), water y 300-1210, near_bank/street_south y>1210, interior y 1440-1620.

tile21.layout: The west half of the Rainbow Bridge fills the tile: the timber arch rises from its near-bank foot at the lower left (x200-330,y900-1015) to the crest at the upper right (x1100,y230); the deck is packed with people, most leaning over the near railing to watch the boat below. Water lies under the arch and to the right, y about 330-1000 (x450-1100), and also under the far-bank terrace at the top-left (x0-160,y250-400). The far bank occupies the top strip (y0-180): a tiled-roof restaurant with a railed terrace at the left, bare trees, an open-air dining terrace with rows of tables and umbrella stalls at the right. The near bank is a road along the left and bottom (x0-550,y200-1350) with the bridge-foot stalls, a sedan chair, donkeys and a crowd; a thatched shed stall (x490-880,y1000-1255), the bird-vane pole (x455-555), and a large tiled-roof building (y1180-1800) with a colored-gate frame and umbrella stalls fill the bottom.

tile22.layout: Water fills the upper-middle of the tile: from the far-bank boats (y~380) down to the near-bank shoreline, which runs diagonally from the right edge at y~290 down to the left, past the stall awning (x700,y560) and the moored boat (x100-560,y740-950); water y~200-950 at the left, narrowing to a wedge at the upper right. The far bank is the top strip (y0-305): from left to right a house with a lattice veranda, a long hall with a counter and tables on piles, a small pavilion, two umbrellas and a large tiled-roof restaurant with a railed dining terrace on piles; a large passenger boat (mast down) and a smaller mat-roofed boat are moored below them (y205-382). The near bank (lower half) is a dense market west of the Rainbow Bridge foot: a cargo boat with six men on its bow, two lean-to mat sheds and a giant umbrella stall at the water's edge (y860-1250), a mat-awning stall with coiled goods (x695-1035,y505-730), and an open street (road band, y~550-1750) with crowds, pack donkeys, a ridden donkey, porters and a single-wheel cart pulled by a donkey. The bottom-right corner (x670-1100,y1500-1800) is the tiled roof of a large near-bank building with umbrella stalls behind its ridge; the bridge itself is just beyond the right edge (tile21).

tile23.layout: Top band (y 0-200) is the far bank: a continuous tiled roof along the top edge (y 0-70) over a row of open-front shops with tables (x 500-1100, y 70-180), a small two-storey house with an open balcony at top-left (x 0-200, y 80-205), a large bare tree at x 340-580, and a sloping earth bank (y 180-240). A line of five moored boats with plank cabins and awnings lies along the far bank (y 210-395) from x 0 to 1100. Open water fills y 240-1000 in the centre and left. Near bank (lower right): a boat stern with two boatmen and a bird-topped pole at x 780-1100, y 680-900, then a thatched open shed with a cup/bowl display at x 860-1100, y 920-1310. The lower-left third is the wine house 十千脚店: a huge bamboo 彩楼欢门 (x 90-640, y 500-1600) rising above its tiled gate, with the main tiled building and a railed ramp at x 0-330, y 1180-1800. The street (band 'road') runs along the bottom, y 1300-1800, from the gate (x 450) to the right edge, with a loaded two-wheeled cart, an umbrella stall and walking figures.

tile24.layout: Open river water fills the upper two thirds of the tile (y 0 to about 920 on the left, to about 700 on the right), reading as a wide bend receding to the upper left. The far bank enters at the top right: a sandy shore line runs from (440,110) down to (580,250), with a path on it (y 40-130) along which a donkey train climbs away to the upper left; beyond are willows, a tiled house with an open verandah and a fence, and a long plank-cabin passenger boat moored along that bank (y 225-410). In mid-water a towed cargo boat with mast raised sits at the upper left (x150-440), and at the left edge a boat's crew of five push a huge sweep oar. The near bank is hidden by two large leafless trees (y 600-1200); in front of them stands the two-storey wine house (roof y 930-1240, open upper floor with guests y 1240-1500), a neighbouring large hip roof to its right (y 1160-1760), foreground shrubs, and at the right edge the raised mast and rigging frame of a boat moored at the quay (x 960-1100).

tile25.layout: Water fills the upper part of the tile, from the top edge down to about y 880 on the left (shore under the moored boats) and y 950 on the right (reeds). A strip of far bank with a tile-roofed building, a fence and a bare tree shows only in the top-left corner (y 0-120). The water carries a stacked cluster of moored cargo boats at the left (x 0-500, y 160-610), a large moored cargo boat lying along the near bank (x 0-1000, y 560-900), a flat-roofed boat at the top, a boat with a five-man stern sweep crew at the right (x 640-1100, y 215-535) and a boat cut by the right edge. The near bank (y 850-1270) carries a huge leafless willow (x 280-905), a thatched vendor shed at the left with a small roofed stand and two men talking, a gnarled bare tree and reeds. The lower third (y 950-1800) is all roofs: a two-storey restaurant with an open upper gallery at the right (x 590-1100), a gable-roofed house at the left, an annex and a large hip roof filling the bottom-left, with fine-twigged trees at the bottom right. No street surface is visible in this tile.

tile26.layout: The river occupies the upper right of the tile: water from the top edge (y about 150 at x 950-1100) widening down and to the left, bounded by the far bank at the upper left (houses at y 0-320 and a dirt road at y 300-450 sloping to the water at x 600-820) and by the near bank at the lower right (y about 800-880, x 780-1100) where a big mat umbrella and a mat lean-to stand. Four boats are moored along the right edge (y 150-760), the nearest a large roofed passenger boat whose bow points lower-left. The upper left is filled by one huge gnarled tree and a cluster of fine-twig bare trees. The middle band (y 560-1250) is a large riverside tea house with a tiled hip-gable roof, an open hall under a woven-mat awning, tables and benches and five seated customers, on a raised terrace; a vendor with a red basin sits under the mat lean-to at its right end. The bottom band (y 1110-1800) is entirely the tiled roofs of a large building complex (ridges, hip corners, ridge ornaments, a decorated gable end at the lower left); no street level is visible there.

tile27.layout: No water in this tile. The whole tile is a street scene at the far end of the city. Top band (y 0-400): background roofs - a big hipped tile roof with a walled courtyard of tables (y 40-150), a long open gallery with benches running diagonally (y 180-335), thatched huts and a mass of large bare trees (x 540-1100). Middle band (y 380-1120) is the open street (north side): a crowd of about 15 people gathered in front of a mat-roofed shop at the left (x 20-330), a loaded donkey train walking left (x 470-700), a porter and an old man with a T-staff, the wheelwright's workshop in front of a giant two-trunk tree (x 450-1000) with a wheel, planks and a leaning cart frame, and a saddled horse being readied in front of an open teahouse (x 0-280, y 690-1080). Bottom band (y 1060-1800) is the south side: a heavy covered ox cart with two oxen and two attendants at the left (x 0-480), and the hipped tile roofs of large two-storey buildings seen from behind at the right (x 180-1100).

tile28.layout: No water in this tile. The top half is a dense treeline: a huge gnarled willow (trunk x90-470, y450-1000) with bare trees behind and an old leafy tree at the upper right; a thatched roof shows through the trees along the top edge. Below the trees a large open-front restaurant with a lattice-thatch hip roof (x330-1100, y420-1000) faces the main street (y950-1300), where a big straw-covered freight cart stands. At the upper right a thatched shed with a group of men marks a side street running up to the right (y370-660). At the left a thatched fortune-teller's hut (x0-255, y440-820) with cloth signs stands by an open road (x0-130, y760-1000) passing the willow. The lower left is a tiled-roof shop (x0-770, y1090-1800) facing a lower street (y1560-1800) with a mule rider, a groom and a porter; a second covered freight cart stands at the junction at x690-1072, y1278-1662.

tile29.layout: No water in this tile. The top band (y 0-420) is the back of a walled compound: a tiled building with a veranda and a fenced yard holding a horse (x250-630), flanked by large bare willows at left and right, and a huge gnarled bare tree rising at x600-760. A spiked wooden palisade (y370-420) with a red-columned gatehouse and an open red studded door (x265-585) closes the compound; in the yard in front (y540-720) six soldiers/guards idle, sit and sleep beside leaning pole-weapons and a furled banner. A low rail fence with a brushwood mound (y720-830) separates the yard from the open street band (y700-1050) that runs left-right; at its right end stands a mat-roofed fortune-teller booth with three signs (決疑/看命/神課), a table, the fortune-teller, a seated customer and five or so onlookers. A tall banner pole with a striped cloth flag stands at x570. The lower half (y1030-1800) is two large tiled buildings: a restaurant/tea hall at the left with an open front, tables, benches and a few guests, and a hip-roofed house with a gabled annex at the right; a man leans over the right roof ridge; bare trees fill the bottom.

tile30.layout: A land tile with no water. The top-left corner holds an open-fronted building and a small roadside booth with a counter, with two loaded (charcoal?) donkeys passing in front (base y~540). Four large willows (three pollarded, one with a gnarled hollow trunk) rise from a hedge/fence line at y~550-830 and fill the top half with drooping branches; at the right, in a yard closed by a pointed-stake palisade with spear shafts leaning on it, two men doze on the ground. A broad road runs across the middle (y~520-1250 at left, y~790-1110 at right): on its north lane two closed sedans are carried leftward with bearers and attendants (y~610-845), followed by porters with shoulder poles; on its south lane a large mat-covered ox cart drawn by two oxen in tandem moves right, led by a bearded driver (y~860-1280). The bottom third (y~1040-1800) is roofs of the south-side buildings seen from above among a big bare tree, a willow and bamboo clumps: a huge hip roof at left, a finial roof at bottom centre, and at the bottom right a long building with a mat awning and a yard full of tables and benches with one or two seated figures. A vertical silk crease runs through x~415-428 (y~600-1350); another faint seam near x~1078.

tile31.layout: No water in this tile; it is a dense street scene. The top band (y0-330) holds the street-side buildings: a top-left house with veranda, a long tiled gate hall with a studded central door and lattice side bays (x250-775), and at top right a tiled shop where a man weighs goods with a steelyard, with a thatched shed and three loaded donkeys at its right. Large pines fill the left half from the top down to y900, with a herd of five pigs moving right under their branches (x610-780, y330-455) and a low fence at x612-742, y590-660. The street runs diagonally from upper right (porter, saddled horse with grooms, arched structure) down to the lower left; along its left side are a mat awning with a donkey and two umbrella stalls (pale umbrella with a huge basket of reddish goods and bending customers; brown umbrella with round goods), and in the middle and right of y880-1480 two large covered carts: the left one (x0-380) drawn to the right by a team of about five oxen with drivers and a running man, the right one (x775-1050) moving right with a draught animal at the edge. The lower right (y1215-1800) is the wide tiled hip roof of a large building with pines; at bottom left three people converse (bearded man with staff, child, man gesturing) and a seated man watches.

tile32.layout: A flat timber bridge with railings crosses the whole lower-middle of the tile: its far railing runs at y~1070-1195 from the left edge to x~720 and its near railing at y~1465-1560 from the left edge to x~515, with timber abutment framing under the right end (x300-650, y1590-1730). The bridge deck (walking surface y~1190-1470) carries about 30 people: a row of onlookers leaning on the far rail with their backs to the viewer, a row leaning on the near rail facing the viewer, a stooped porter with two baskets, two men tugging one stick, and three donkeys walking right, one ridden by a bearded elder with his groom. Plain silk (water of the canal/moat, no ripple lines drawn) shows above the bridge between the trees (y~440-1070) and below it at the left (y~1590-1800, x0-330). At the right end of the bridge (x700-1100) a large two-wheeled mat-covered cart stands at the bridgehead under a tilted mat sunshade and a big brown umbrella stall. The top band (y0-450) is the far bank: a road with tiny travellers (a small sedan, a donkey rider, a pole carrier), tile-roofed houses at the top right, and large gnarled needle trees whose crowns fill y130-450; more needle trees frame the left and right edges and the foreground lower right.

tile33.layout: Top half (y0-1000) is tree canopy: a pine at the top-right corner, willows with gnarled trunks at x120-260, x320-425 and behind the cart (x~620-680), an old dark-twigged tree at the right, and a large round red collector's seal at x497-722,y95-302. A few buildings are only glimpsed behind the trunks (y830-1012). The open road before the gate runs across y~1000-1460: a crowd of standing men and a seated old man at the left, a wide-hat rider on a horse with groom and luggage porter, two men resting on a bench under the central willow, a large two-wheeled covered cart pulled right by a mule with carters, and three pole porters (y1285-1460). A wooden railing with onlookers at the upper right (y1030-1185) is probably the far railing of the flat timber bridge whose near railing (y1465-1590) carries three men leaning and looking down; the bridge's trestle piers stand in water (y~1590-1765). A low foreground pine covers the bottom-left (x0-565, y1330-1770).

tile34.layout: No water in this tile. The upper-left two thirds are the city gate: a timber gate tower (x0-770,y0-700) with a single-eave hip roof, bracket sets, balustraded balcony and a lower railed terrace, standing on a massive battered platform (x25-900,y400-1340) whose outer face turns to the right (outside the city) and is pierced by one flat-topped trapezoidal timber-framed passage (x460-750,y590-1340). A camel is walking out of the passage to the right; outside the gate, on open ground at the right (x750-1100,y960-1440), a rider on a dark animal, nine men standing, leaning or sitting close together, and a porter with a carrying pole walks away to the right. No city wall joins the platform: the lower-left is an earth bank with gnarled trees and pines (x0-700,y830-1765), and the right side and bottom are filled with large pines.

tile35.layout: No water in this tile. The right half is dominated by a large gate tower (城楼) on a high brick-faced podium (x560-1100, y20-560) with a balcony, a stair down to a railed lower terrace (y560-830), and a long ramp with a central stair (马道, x505-830, y760-1255) descending toward the street at the bottom. The left half is the tax office: an open-fronted tile-roofed hall on red columns (x0-548, y480-1000) with clerks at a table and a pile of bales on the street in front (y870-1012). The street (y1000-1430) runs across the lower-left where a train of four loaded camels walks left past the office, led by a drover. The bottom band (y1430-1800) is street level in front of the wall: a mat awning with a hawker and a customer, a man carrying sticks, a stall at the left edge, and a small tile-roofed gate booth (x408-645). Above the office are tile roofs of houses and clusters of bare trees; the top band (y0-260) is an open field with a lying buffalo and a calf. Large bare trees fill the lower right in front of the wall.

tile36.layout: No water. The upper-left half (x0-760, y0-905) is a large two-storey wine house with a huge hip-and-gable tile roof, drinking customers on the upper floor, a bamboo 彩楼欢门 scaffold hung with flowers and festoons across its front, and a standing sign 香□ at its door; to its right an open shed (x405-805, y500-900) where bare-torsoed coopers bend bamboo hoops over a row of large casks, and behind the roofs a yard with stacked wine jars and willows (top right). A big willow (trunk x700-785) separates the shed from the tax office at the right edge (x800-1100, y465-930), where a clerk sits at a table and another stands reading a register. The main street runs across y~880-1440: in front of the wine house a heavy two-wheeled sack cart with a team of horses/donkeys, grooms, porters, two donkeys and a man with a sack pole; at the right the last loaded Bactrian camel of the caravan walking right toward the gate. The near side of the street (y1170-1440) has a pointing child, a stele, a rider with a groom and two dark mat-covered masses (probably covered carts) with three men; the bottom band (y1435-1775) is foreground tile roofs, a bare tree and a man with a board under an eave.

tile37.layout: No water in this tile: it is the city street in front of the big wine house 孙羊正店. The top half (y0-890) is the wine house: a two-storey main hall with a huge tile hip-gable roof (x440-1100, y15-267), upper-floor lattice windows and railing (y270-422) with two people upstairs, and across its front a tall multi-tier decorated gate (彩楼欢门, x225-1100, y150-890) of bound poles dressed with red flowers, scroll ornaments, spires and hanging lantern balls and boxes; the lantern-box signs 正店, 孫□ and 香□ stand at its posts. At the upper left are tiled roofs and a large pine (x0-520, y0-425) and a side wing with the vertical sign 孫羊店 (x0-330, y400-760), in front of which a food stall stands under a big umbrella (x0-312, y715-1040). The shop-front street strip (street_north, y840-1130) holds a dense crowd of 18 people (3 more stand inside the open ground floor), two very large wicker baskets, a red slat fence and a dog. The road below (y1130-1400) carries two closed sedan chairs with their bearers moving left and a running child. The bottom band (y1300-1730) is foreground: an umbrella stall, a two-storey building at bottom left, low tile roofs, a large pine-like tree and a large bare tree, and behind a long roof ridge at the right some tripod frames, poles, a man's head and a stele-like standing sign.

tile38.layout: No water in this tile: it is the dense city crossroads around the 孫羊店 building. The top band (y 0-210) is the far (north) side of a street lined with shopfronts: an open shop under a dark flat awning with six small plaques and the standing sign □錦疋帛鋪, a wheelbarrow at the top-left corner, two men talking in the street, and at the top right a tile-roofed shop with the hanging sign 楊家應症. A side road runs from the upper left down to the middle (y 200-700): a large box cart with a big wheel pulled leftward by four donkeys and a man in the traces, a separate team of three draught animals driven to the right by a man walking behind them, a huge umbrella stall with tables at the left edge and a sack-laden cart cut by the left edge. The right half from y 25 to 800 is the huge multi-roofed 孫羊店 building with a tall red signboard behind it; in front of its open shop front (hanging meat) a dense ring of 19 people (y 700-1060) surrounds a bearded central man, two griddle stalls under umbrellas stand at its right, and at its left a rider seen from behind with two grooms, a boy and two walkers. The near street (y 1030-1420) holds porters with shoulder poles, gentlemen talking, a man with a round fan, an umbrella stall with a vertical sign, two more umbrellas at the right and the standing sign 久住王員外家 at the left; the bottom band (y 1345-1800) is the roofs of the inn and a large two-storey building with an upper-floor room (a man at the window), with pines at the lower left.

tile39.layout: No water in this tile; it is a dense city crossroads inside the walls. The upper half is filled by roofs: several tile roofs at the top-left, the huge hip roof of the Liu incense shop (刘家上色沉檀拣香, x340-970) with a 彩楼欢门 pole gateway, an inscribed eave board and a tall standing sign at its front (x813-853, y342-548), and a dark-roofed shop with benches at the right (x860-1100, y140-530); a far street with a wheelbarrow, a porter and two men at a railing shows above the roofs (y0-160). A large pine covers the left roofs (x0-445, y95-690). The open street occupies y~560-1800: four large stall umbrellas over a crowd at a goods stall (x0-810, y640-1100) in front of a low building, a handcart at the Liu shop, a rider and two white-robed scholars at the right, and in the lower half porters with baskets, a monk group, a pointing group, a man teaching a toddler to walk and a donkey-drawn cart loaded with two big casks. At the bottom-right are the 久住王员外家 inn sign (x930-988, y1300-1530), a roof corner, two flat stall umbrellas over a small stall and a second large pine.

tile40.layout: No water in this tile; it is a dense city street (Kaifeng inner city). Top band y 0-600: overlapping tiled roofs of houses on the far (north) side, with clumps of bamboo-like trees (x 470-905, y 10-250) and one large old willow whose fine drooping branches spread from x 350 to 1100 (trunk x 830-945, y 600-950). Upper left x 0-390, y 300-1000: the open-fronted 趙太丞家 clinic with its plaque row and vertical remedy signboards, a consultation (woman with child) inside. Centre: a public well with 井-shaped frame on a square brick platform (x 480-880, y 860-1000) before a white wall, three water drawers; two large parasols of a stall under the willow at right (x 840-1100, y 635-940). Street band y ~960-1270: an official in a wide hat on a white horse with three servants (left), a toy/sundries peddler with tall canopy rack, strollers and men conversing. Foreground (near/south side): a big tiled hip roof (x 0-660, y 1220-1775), a flat mat awning (x 450-935, y 1255-1375) over a crowd gathered at the booth with the 解 signboard (x 590-960, y 1370-1700), a rider entering the crowd from behind, and standing men at right; the scroll's lower edge is at y≈1775.

tile41.layout: No water in this tile: it is the last section of the scroll, a city street scene ending at the scroll's left edge (a plain silk strip at x 0-12 and the lower border y≈1780-1800). The upper half is a residential compound: a large main-hall roof (y 0-335) and further roofs behind a gatehouse whose open doorway (x 330-560, y 640-850) faces the street, with a low railing and two tall willows to its left (x 0-445, y 0-900). On the right, the open-fronted clinic 趙太丞家 (x 630-804, y 495-1000) has name plaques under its eave, a woman with a child and a seated man inside, and two tall standing signboards in front (x 558-646). The street runs across the middle (y≈850-1245) with a sack carrier, a man at the sign, a pole porter, and at the right a rider in a wide hat on a white horse with an attendant (continuing into tile40). The lower part is the near side of the street: rooftops seen from above at the bottom right (x 478-804, y 1140-1800) and a bud-tipped bare tree and pines filling the bottom left (x 0-565, y 930-1790). Red collector seals line the left edge.

entries.activity: Large tree with a forked trunk: two gnarled stems rise from a common base at x 560-720, y 900-960; the left stem climbs to y 400, the right stem sends a long branch far to the right (to x 1060) with crooked twigs and leaf dots.
entries.notes: Size large. The base sits on the upper edge of the river bank. A low side branch droops right at y 760-820.

entries.activity: Rocky earthen river bank (far bank) running the full width of the tile, dropping from the field to the water with dark ink-washed rock ledges.
entries.notes: Heaviest ink at x 300-700, y 1130-1250; the bank line slopes slightly downward to the right.

entries.activity: Dark horizontal wash band along the bottom of the tile, reading as the near shore (or a mist/water shading band) below the open water.
entries.notes: No drawn detail; darkest at x 0-500.

entries.activity: Dead broken snag: a short trunk stub leaning to the upper left, snapped off with two splintered points, standing between the tall tree and the forked tree.
entries.notes: Size small; no twigs or leaves; may be a broken limb of t01-007.

entries.activity: Tall slender tree with a nearly straight trunk (x 490-545) rising from the field; the crown bends to the left at the top with a spray of fine twigs and leaf dots.
entries.notes: Size large (about 730 px tall). Secondary branches spread right at y 420-520.

entries.activity: Drover walking left close behind the laden donkey, leaning forward, right arm raised and holding a thin stick or whip that trails to the right; left arm hangs by the donkey's pack.
entries.notes: Trousers tied at the ankle, legs in mid-stride; small figure about 95 px tall. The rest of the train (more donkeys and a second drover) is in tile02.

entries.activity: Donkey walking left along the path carrying two tall woven pannier baskets slung either side of a pack saddle.
entries.load: pair of woven basketwork panniers (charcoal), one each side of the pack saddle
entries.notes: Head low, ears forward, all four legs visible; the panniers are drawn with a cross-hatched weave pattern, dark lower half.

entries.activity: Faint second trunk at the tile's right edge beside the thick tree.
entries.notes: Size medium; mostly outside the tile; may be a branch of t02-013.

entries.activity: Faint tufted crown of a far-off tree at the right edge.
entries.notes: Size small; pale ink; continues into tile01.

entries.activity: Low ink-washed sandbar or shoal lying in the water at the lower left, tapering to the right.
entries.notes: Continues into tile02.

entries.activity: Fourth pack donkey, head and long ears raised, emerging from behind the thick trunk of the right-hand tree.
entries.notes: Partly occluded by the trunk of t02-013; ears clearly drawn upright.

entries.activity: Faint tufted crown of a far-off tree, top right.
entries.notes: Size small; pale ink.

entries.activity: Very thick old tree at the right edge with a heavy knotted trunk (x 980-1060) standing at the right end of the footbridge; donkeys pass behind it.
entries.notes: Size large; trunk shows dark knots; branches go up-left to join the crown of t02-012; continues into tile01.

entries.activity: Row of short dark stakes with a horizontal rail at the foot of the big tree, on the bank edge at the left tile edge.
entries.notes: Could instead be the corner of a thatched shed or a wattle wall; the object continues into tile02 where it should be resolved.

entries.activity: Third pack donkey, walking left below the big right-hand tree, carrying a lower pack load.
entries.load: pack load, smaller than the first two (baskets or bundles)
entries.notes: Drawn in paler ink; head dark and lowered; a dark saddle-cloth under the load.

entries.activity: Band of mist/pale wash behind the path that hides the ground beyond the donkey train.
entries.notes: Atmospheric, not an object; included so the reconstruction knows the far ground is hidden here.

entries.activity: Faint tufted crown of a far-off tree above the right grove.
entries.notes: Size small; pale ink.

entries.activity: Far-bank edge: a curved earth bank below the donkey path, above the footbridge.
entries.notes: Dark outline strokes; the path the donkeys use runs above it at y 700-920.

entries.activity: Second pack donkey, walking left close behind the first, carrying two charcoal baskets.
entries.notes: Slightly lower on the path than the first (nearer the viewer); hindquarters overlap the first donkey's rear.

entries.activity: Wooden plank footbridge on timber trestle piles crossing the creek, slightly humped in the middle; nobody on it.
entries.notes: About 7 pile groups visible below the deck (x~618, 705, 742, 837, 870, 925, 963); dark dotted line along the deck edge suggests low edge boards or railing posts; right end lands at the foot of tree t02-013.

entries.activity: Large spreading bare tree above the donkey path; trunk at x 840-890 with long branches arching left over the path and right into the next tree.
entries.notes: Size large; base hidden behind donkey t02-004; small dark twig tufts along all branches.

entries.activity: First pack donkey of the train, walking left behind the driver with two tall charcoal baskets lashed on its back.
entries.load: two pannier baskets of charcoal, dark lumps visible on top
entries.notes: Load drawn as a pair of square baskets with a dark hatched top; legs thin, head low.

entries.activity: Small flat-bottomed boat moored empty at the bank below the footbridge, bow to the left.
entries.notes: no_mast, open (no cabin); drawn in very faint outline, two cross-thwarts visible; no people aboard.

entries.activity: Faint tufted crown of a far-off tree.
entries.notes: Size small; pale ink.

entries.activity: Walks leftward ahead of the loaded donkeys, head turned back toward the train, a thin whip or switch held up over his shoulder.
entries.notes: Small figure, trousers hitched; the line over the shoulder is faint, could be a whip or a lead rope.

entries.activity: Faint tufted crown of a far-off tree.
entries.notes: Size small; pale ink.

entries.activity: Dark wedge-shaped sand spit / low bank lying in the river below the grove.
entries.notes: Drawn with dark horizontal wash; further pale banks at y 1430-1520 to the right (x 850-1100).

entries.activity: Open river surface with two dark horizontal mist/water bands at y 1560-1610 and 1690-1760.
entries.notes: No boats or figures on this stretch of water.

entries.activity: Tall bare tree with a straighter trunk (x 440-520) rising to the top of the grove, right of the big gnarled tree.
entries.notes: Size large; trunk forks at about y 700; crown reaches y 280.

entries.activity: Faint tufted crown of a far-off tree.
entries.notes: Size small; pale radiating tuft.

entries.activity: The largest tree of the grove: thick gnarled trunk (x 320-420) with knot holes, bending right then arching up into a wide crown of bare twig clusters.
entries.notes: Size large; two dark knot holes on the trunk at about (355,1010) and (345,1085); twig tips drawn as small upward clusters (elm/jujube type), no leaves.

entries.activity: Faint round tufted crown of a far-off tree at the top of the tile.
entries.notes: Size small; drawn as a pale radiating tuft (could be a distant willow or pine).

entries.activity: Distant pale bare tree, crown of thin upward twigs.
entries.notes: Size medium; pale ink.

entries.activity: Left bank: low earthen bank with exposed tree roots where the boat is moored.
entries.notes: Natural bank, not a built quay; bank edge line runs at y 1130-1170 from x 0 to 250 then down to the water at x 550.

entries.activity: Second small bank hummock with brush below the first, at the tile edge.
entries.notes: cut by tile edge.

entries.activity: Short dark reed/shrub strokes on top of the right bank hummock.
entries.notes: small; cut by tile edge.

entries.activity: Low mounded bank with shrubs/reed clumps at the far right edge, in mist.
entries.notes: cut by tile edge; continues in tile02; grey wash hummocks with short dark reed strokes on top.

entries.activity: Soft misty tree crown at the top right corner, grey wash.
entries.notes: medium; blurred; cut by tile right edge.

entries.activity: Bare tree at the front of the grove with clearly drawn forked branches; low dark branch sweeping down-left to the ground.
entries.notes: large; dark crisp twigs with small leaf-dots; trunk x~1010-1050; lower branch tips at x900-1010,y780-835; cut by tile right edge; continues in tile02.

entries.activity: Grove tree with broad fine-twig crown, trunk at x~930 descending to y~810.
entries.notes: large; crown merges with neighbours; two thin trunks x~920 and x~960.

entries.activity: Low dark bushes on the left bank edge at the tile's left margin.
entries.notes: Size small; dark dotted tufts, possibly reeds.

entries.activity: Grove tree with dense fine-twig crown, trunk at x~835 down to the bank.
entries.notes: large; bare/budding fine twigs drawn as hatched mass; several thin trunks around it (x~790, 835, 880).

entries.activity: Tall grove tree with soft misty crown and a straight trunk running down to the ground at x~750.
entries.notes: large; trunk x742-760 visible from y340 to y795.

entries.activity: Misty pale tree crown at the top centre-right, grey wash.
entries.notes: medium; blurred; belongs to the grove behind.

entries.activity: Large pollarded willow with a thick gnarled trunk beside the shed; round crown of fine bare twigs, long twigs trailing down to the right.
entries.notes: large; trunk at x420-570 with knotted burl at x505-575,y595-655; trunk base at x~430-470,y~720; twigs sweep down to y~720 on the right side.

entries.activity: Misty pale tree clump above the willow crown, grey wash.
entries.notes: medium; blurred by mist; no trunk.

entries.activity: Second low wooden table/bench under the open shed, right of the post.
entries.notes: 4 legs; same height as the left one; something dark leans on/over it (see t03 possible figure).

entries.activity: Wooden bench standing in front of the shed on the open ground.
entries.notes: 4 splayed legs, flat top; a small loop-shaped mark on the top (object or knot).

entries.activity: Open-fronted thatched lean-to running right from the house, with tables and a bench beneath it.
entries.notes: thatched single-slope roof, posts at x~340,390,440,500 (base y~790-860); fully open front; furniture underneath (t03 tables/bench).

entries.activity: Possible seated/bent figure under the open shed beside the table; may instead be a hanging object.
entries.notes: angular dark shape with a rounded top; read at 10x zoom; treat as uncertain - the opening farmstead may well be empty.

entries.activity: Second willow crown (round brush of thin upward twigs) behind the main willow, over the shed roof.
entries.notes: medium-large; dense radiating fine twigs; trunk hidden behind the main willow/roof; bare early-spring willow.

entries.activity: Dark vertical object hanging from or leaning against the shed post, left of the possible figure.
entries.notes: could be a hanging mat, a sack, or part of the shed's post.

entries.activity: Low wooden table or long bench standing under the open shed, left of the post.
entries.notes: 4 legs visible, dark top edge; may be a bench.

entries.activity: Soft misty tree clump behind the farmhouse roof, drawn in pale grey wash without trunk.
entries.notes: medium; mist-blurred foliage mass; no trunk visible.

entries.activity: Stacked tiered object (stack of baskets or steamers) standing on the ground inside the hut near its right post.
entries.notes: 3-4 horizontal bands, tapered; could also be a bee-skep or a stacked crate.

entries.activity: Gate passage (门道) through the platform; a camel is coming out of it to the right.
entries.notes: Single passage. SHAPE: flat-topped trapezoidal (梯形) timber-framed opening - no arch or vault curve anywhere. Both jambs lean: left jamb from ~(465,770) down to ~(560,1330); right jamb from ~(605,655) to ~(690,950) and on to ~(745,1330); the opening is narrower at the top. A framed board (t34-004) covers the top of the opening. INSIDE: the left wall of the passage shows a row of tall vertical timber posts/planks (排叉柱-like, x470-575,y720-1330); the far wall of the passage is drawn with close horizontal hatching (x570-700). No door leaves are visible. The passage axis runs left-right through the platform; floor level at the mouth ~y1335. Cut-off: the camel's rear is hidden behind the left jamb.

entries.activity: Massive gate platform (城台/墩台) that carries the tower and is pierced by the gate passage.
entries.notes: SHAPE: the outer gate face faces right (outside the city) and is drawn obliquely, receding to the upper right: top edge from the near corner (~345,690) up to the far corner (~690,410); the far edge is battered (leans outward toward the bottom) from (690,410) to about (885,1000); the near corner is a dark shaded strip (x345-480 at the top, x480-520 at y1260) that also leans - clear batter (收分) on all visible edges, so the platform is wider at the base than at the top. The front (viewer-facing) face is visible only above and between the trees at x25-345,y810-1000 (horizontal hatching; left edge line at x~30). SURFACE: dense fine parallel hatching everywhere (diagonal on the outer face, horizontal inside the passage) - reads as brick courses or rammed-earth layers. CONDITION: no cracks, breaches, missing patches or plants growing on the platform are drawn - it looks intact and maintained. TOP: no crenellated parapet (女墙/雉堞) or any defensive work; the top edge carries only the timber balustrades of the tower. WALL: no city wall is visible joining the platform on either side in this tile - to the right (outside) there are only trees and open ground, in front-left only trees on an earth bank (t34-028).

entries.notes: Tiers from the top: (1) CREST above the upper-floor railing, y150-425: six tall pointed spire frames bound with red ties and dressed with red flowers and leaves, some topped by a red bud-shaped finial, at x430-470 (left corner post, with a small lozenge ornament at y263-280), 615-672, 735-792, 860-918, 958-1005, 1045-1096; large curling scroll ornaments (cloud/ruyi-like) between them at x520-560 y290-385 and x940-1005 y360-415; the crest screens the upper-storey windows. (2) UPPER BAND y370-480: long horizontal entablature with two red-painted beams running from x225 to the right edge; its left end turns back diagonally (x225-320) like a hipped corner. (3) MIDDLE TIER y480-600: band of X-braced lattice frames with flower garlands and tassels; scroll ornaments at x395-453 y527-593, x620-660 y460-535, x798-865 y485-552, x1032-1090 y543-627; on the centre axis (x600-900, y380-640) a dense tower of red flowers rising through tiers 1-3. (4) LOWER PENT EAVE y590-720 with a red-striped beam; its centre part x490-1000 projects forward as a polygonal bay with angled ends (x490-560 and x900-1000), lined below with vertical slats. (5) HANGING LANTERNS at the front of the lower eave: big white lattice ball (x718-778) flanked by two diamond lantern boxes (x659-700, x805-849); under the eave a tilted square lattice box (x395-455), a lattice ball on a pole (x484-546), a lattice ball (x960-1015) and a flower knot (x1040-1098). (6) GROUND: posts at about x330, 450, 510, 640, 700, 960, 1000 reach the street at y880-890; red vase-shaped lanterns hang on the outer posts (x287-335, x913-958); lantern-box signs 正店, 孫□ and 香□ stand at the post feet; colours: red/vermilion on beams and flowers, ink lines, pale lanterns
